correctness.rationale: The exact periodic harmonic solutions and circular-arc intersection yield the two-branch statistic; analytic differentiation gives a strictly decreasing-in-cutoff sign test and a single cutoff root per eligible frequency. Endpoint limits make its maximum attained and sharp. The contrast limit uses uniform compact convergence with an explicit global tail bound. The rational positive-derivative witness is exact. The 17,475 deterministic checker assertions supplement the proof.

value.rationale: A single dryness cutoff applied to physically motivated fast and slow fuel-moisture time-lag classes gives a meaningful joint dry-exposure statistic not determined by mean moisture. The theorem supplies an exact frequency-recovery/no-recovery boundary and a universal small-lag-contrast slope, revealing when classwise shrinking intervals fail to imply shrinking concurrent exposure. It is a mathematical benchmark rather than an empirical fire hazard forecast.
